title: Example 138: window start as the window's index times its length, proved equal by the own checker
description: Regression proof of Crosscut's Window#counted with the start computed as nowNanos / windowNanos * windowNanos against the remainder form, by the tool's own checker (approach.engine native): expected verified. The checker rewrites a quotient times its divisor as the dividend less the remainder, so both versions are the same bits; the library's run took 0.1 s. JBMC did not finish the same harness within 60 s.

resources.notes: the last run used a stale jvmcontract; measured by the submitting sessions in seconds at under 200 MiB, except 142 at bound 8, 7 s
